_comment: Octail egg for any SteamCMD dedicated server (plan §6.4). Install script adapted from pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd (MIT licence). Set the app id and the startup command per game; anonymous SteamCMD only. Generic UDP idle sleep (off until staff enable it per server).
name: Generic SteamCMD game
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Installs any dedicated server that SteamCMD can download anonymously (Valheim, Palworld, 7 Days to Die, Project Zomboid, ...). Set the Steam app id, the server binary and its arguments; AUTO_UPDATE re-runs SteamCMD on every start.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Generic SteamCMD install (Octail). Server files: /mnt/server
set -e

if [ -z "${SRCDS_APPID}" ]; then
    echo "SRCDS_APPID is not set: give the egg variable 'Steam app id' a value."
    exit 1
fi

## SteamCMD
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise, even as root. Tentacle gives the files back to the server user afterwards.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

BETA=""
if [ -n "${SRCDS_BETAID}" ]; then BETA="-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}"; fi
if [ -n "${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ]; then BETA="${BETA} -betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}"; fi
PLATFORM=""
if [ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]; then PLATFORM="+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows"; fi

# Anonymous login only (logged-in Steam accounts come with plan §6.7). SteamCMD sometimes exits
# non-zero on the first run while it updates itself, so try up to three times.
for attempt in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous ${PLATFORM} +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} ${BETA} validate +quit; then
        break
    fi
    echo "SteamCMD failed (attempt ${attempt})."
    if [ "${attempt}" == "3" ]; then exit 1; fi
done

## Steam client libraries many servers need
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so || true
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so || true

if [ -n "${SERVER_BINARY}" ] && [ -f "/mnt/server/${SERVER_BINARY}" ]; then
    chmod +x "/mnt/server/${SERVER_BINARY}"
fi
echo "SteamCMD install of app ${SRCDS_APPID} finished."

variables.name: Steam app id
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app id, for example 896660 for Valheim or 2394010 for Palworld (see https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers_List).

variables.name: Server binary
variables.description: The file to run, relative to the server folder, for example valheim_server.x86_64.

variables.name: Server arguments
variables.description: Arguments after the binary. Most games need the port: the server's main port is in the SERVER_PORT environment variable.

variables.name: Automatic updates
variables.description: Run SteamCMD on every start to update the game (1 = on, 0 = off).

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: Leave empty for the default branch.

variables.name: Beta branch password
variables.description: Only for branches that need one.

variables.name: Windows build
variables.description: 1 downloads the Windows build (run it with the Proton image).
